seo_title: Miraflora Wagyu Case Study: GWI Audience Insights | SOMIN
description: SOMIN read GWI data on 1,318,330 affluent Colorado cooks for Miraflora Wagyu, which had a high CPA, and found they are deal sensitive, not price sensitive.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Wagyu eCommerce · Colorado, USA
h1: Miraflora Wagyu's buyers are deal sensitive, not price sensitive
lede: Miraflora Wagyu, a premium US wagyu eCommerce brand, suspected price behind its high CPA. SOMIN's GWI, content and price research found affluent Colorado cooks deal sensitive: 61.4% use discount codes.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · March to May 2024 · Colorado, USA · Cooks, household income 85k and above

challenge.title: Miraflora Wagyu's high CPA and a suspected price problem
challenge.body: Wagyu costs about 3x to 16x more than grass-fed beef. SOMIN read March to May 2024 rival and influencer content on wagyu versus cheaper steaks.

approach.title: GWI survey data, SOMONITOR tracking and price research
points: SOMIN x GWI Q2 2024 survey: 2,838,296 Coloradans interested in cooking, 1,318,330 of them affluent.
Tracked 9 beef brands' key messages, incentives and USPs in SOMONITOR.
Mapped Miraflora's communications onto the awareness-to-advocacy funnel.
Compared per-ounce and per-portion prices of ribeye, New York strip and filet mignon at 6 sellers, plus minimums and shipping.

findings_title: What GWI and SOMONITOR showed about Miraflora's buyers

findings.title: Deal sensitive, not price sensitive
findings.body: 61.0% look for the best deals, 59.3% research before buying and 67.0% use loyalty programmes.

findings.title: Strong on quality, missing from free shipping
findings.body: Against 8 other brands, Miraflora lagged on discounting and was absent from free shipping.

findings.title: Few cooks buy meat online yet
findings.body: 78.7% bought meat in the last month, only 10.1% online: an adoption problem.

delivered.title: A 4Ps plan and 6 personas for Miraflora Wagyu
points: 6 SOMONITOR personas, each with a product pairing and a message
Promotions such as $25 off the Wagyu Prime Gift Box and free first-subscription shipping
Place fixes for freshness, in-person selection and delivery-cost concerns, such as free shipping over a set value
4 SoInspire holiday-meal moments: anxiety, nostalgia, triumph and frustration
A Festive Celebrator concept: 'No More Holiday Hosting Stress'

quote.text: Sensitivity to price is not really about the price but about the perception that they’re getting the best value for their dollar.

outcome.title: Miraflora Wagyu should compete on deals and an easier checkout
outcome.body: Compete on promotions, not price: direct discounts feel like a steal. Drop the forced minimum order, absorb those costs elsewhere and build trust to lift online adoption.

faq.q: What data did SOMIN use for Miraflora Wagyu?
faq.a: SOMIN x GWI Q2 2024 survey data on Colorado cooks, SOMONITOR content, SoInspire reasoning data and competitor prices.
7x Beef, Crowd Cow, GoodChop, Grand Western Steaks, Lone Mountain Wagyu, Miraflora Wagyu, Rastelli's, Snake River Farms and The Wagyu Shop, plus The Meatery and Holy Grail on price.
The Festive Celebrator, The Healthy Foodie, The Sustainability Chef, The Culture Explorer, The Family Prepper and The Grill Master.

faq.q: Where do Colorado cooks find out about brands?
faq.a: Word of mouth: 48.1% of Coloradans find brands through friends and family, and social media recommendations index highest, at 149.7.
